description: Capture recent scrollback from a pane or session to infer context; also extracts recent commands heuristically.

allPanes.description: If true, capture all panes in the session.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

lines.description: How many lines to capture per pane.

target.description: Pane target (pane id or session:window.pane). If omitted, uses active panes in session.

name: tmux_context_history
title: Capture recent tmux history
